transcript.text: This is now an FDA Class 1 blueberry recall, the highest risk level there is with possibility
of death, life-threatening illness, or permanent damage.
Over three hundred forty five hundred thousand pounds of blueberries have been recalled.
Check your fridge right now.
Recall mostly involves public screenwise blueberries and mixed berries, but the infected berries
all came from a company called Fruitas E. Hortelizas from Chile.
Turn your bag over, check the bottom of your box, if you see that name on the bottom, discard
it immediately.
If your blueberry has any of these lot numbers, throw it out or return it.
All affected berries have a best buy or sell-by date of February 9th, 2028.
And don't forget about strawberries, Driscals is currently facing an active class action lawsuit
on the Collect Cell Men Finder app.
Alleging they falsely marketed their conventional strawberries as safe, environmentally responsible
and sustainable grown, while failing to disclose the presence of PFA's related pesticides,
the forever chemicals linked to cancer, immune damage, and hormone disruption.
Independent testing allegedly detected multiple pesticides' residues, and consumers paid a
premium for berries they thought were clean.
If you bought Driscals strawberries, head to the Collect Cell Men Finder app and join the
Driscals lawsuit.
Save this, share it with someone who may have purchased those berries, and follow me for
the next round of recalls and lawsuits.
